title: Repository onboarding file (.lineage.yaml)
description: A repository is onboarded when its default branch holds a valid .lineage.yaml and its CI runs the lineage-ci step (XC-7). The file says which services, schemas and projects the repository holds, what they are called in the graph, and which extractors read them. Extractors are found by detection when not listed. Decision D39.

repository.description: Name used in unit URNs: unit://git/<repository>/<path>

environment.description: The <env> part of svc://<env>/<service>, e.g. otel-demo

owner.description: Default owner; catalog.yaml overrides it per service or dataset

name.description: Becomes svc://<environment>/<name>; must equal the service.name the service emits at runtime

artifact.description: A build output to reuse instead of building, e.g. a compiled descriptor set

projects.description: SQL, stream, feature and model projects

target.description: dbt target with read-only credentials, for compiling in CI

artifact.description: A build output to reuse, e.g. target/manifest.json

reuse_artifacts.description: Prefer outputs the repository's own build already produced

max_minutes.description: IA-1 budget for a PR scan, at the 95th percentile
